v1.feedback: Strong conceptual marriage — Riley's optical interference as a non-Newtonian substrate is legible within seconds and the resist→yield→resolidify arc gives the click real narrative weight. The ochre bleed during yield is the right temperature. Two refinements: the viscous fingering during yield (sin(fingerAngle*7)) reads as a uniform scallop rather than organic Saffman-Taylor instability — perturb finger count per radial band or use a hash of grid position to break symmetry. Second, the re-solidification snap-back (smoothstep 3.0→4.2) is a bit abrupt; a longer elastic settling with slight overshoot (particles wobble past their home positions) would sell the material physics and extend the contemplative window.

The ochre/umber bleed into black regions during yield is a restrained, earned color moment — palette discipline is excellent. Two refinements: the base wave speeds (0.8, 0.5 on uTime) could slow ~40% to feel more unhurried and let the interference pattern read as still-until-stressed; and the elastic overshoot settling (omega 4-6 rad/s) might benefit from a touch more damping so the wobble reads as viscous re-solidification rather than springiness.
